sources.title: GitHub - ssparsh36/Qwen3_-4B--GRPO: Reasoning alignment of Qwen3-4B ...
sources.snippet: Reasoning alignment of Qwen3-4B-Base using GRPO with Unsloth for efficient fine-tuning. Trained on the OpenR1 Math dataset via pre fine-tuning, SFT, and GRPO, achieving +14% accuracy on 2K math problems and reducing hallucinations vs. baseline and SFT-only models.

sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: The Qwen3 series includes models of both dense and Mixture-of-Expert (MoE) architectures, with parameter scales ranging from 0.6 to 235 billion. A key innovation in Qwen3 is the integration of thinking mode (for complex, multi-step reasoning) and non-thinking mode (for rapid, context-driven responses) into a unified framework.

sources.title: Qwen3_ (4B)-GRPO.ipynb - Colab
sources.snippet: Unsloth Goal: To convert Qwen3-4B-Base into a reasoning model via GRPO by using OpenR1's Math dataset. We first pre fine-tune the model to make GRPO skip trying to match formatting - this speeds GRPO up.
